Purpose and values

AMDG: care expressed through accountable work

Ad Majorem Dei Gloriam — “for the greater glory of God.” For this application, four practical commitments connect the Jesuit purpose to advancement operations. They are a proposed mnemonic, not an official expansion of the Latin motto.

Illuminating Excellence · current context

The next obligation is to honor the commitments.

BC High’s 2026 public account describes the $150 million campaign as completed. That makes pledge fulfillment, donor-intent records, reconciled reporting and demonstrable student impact especially relevant to this application. This is an interpretation of the school’s public context, not a claim about its internal systems or final audited receipts. No involvement in the campaign is claimed; confirm the final position with Advancement.

Priorities: human excellence · access and affordability · campus investment. School campaign update ↗ · Published priorities ↗ · Research checked November 2026.

Readiness and trust

A specific ramp, with clear decision rights

First 30 days: map NXT workflows and access with the DBA; rehearse on approved test data; demonstrate a reviewed parallel batch before independent production work. Prior Raiser’s Edge conversion experience is documented; current NXT proficiency requires confirmation.

What the pilot needs: VP-approved scope, approved extracts and a safe test environment, Finance and IT verification, and protected staff review time. Access delays or recurring rework trigger a scope or schedule decision.

Confidentiality: sample donor, student and transaction records are synthetic. No confidential employer records are reproduced. Prior online-giving operations are supported by the career record; a specific PCI assessment or certification is not claimed.

SMARTER · proposed goals, subject to baseline review

What the school could measure

Establish baselines during days 1–30. Confirm targets with the VP and Finance, evaluate monthly, and review or revise at month 6. These are illustrative acceptance targets, not prior achievements or forecasts.

Value to BC High: Advancement and Finance work from the same evidence: one received-gift definition, one signed reconciliation and one traceable report. The VP receives a documented adopt, revise or stop decision. Capacity economics remain supporting analysis.

Scope aligned to the Director of Advancement Services posting and school employment page. Sample workflows require institutional review and authorized access before use.
